events.summary: Pippin leads the Tooks into the Battle of Bywater, giving Merry enough Hobbits to deal with the ruffians.
events.quote: The Tooks marched in with Pippin at their head.

events.summary: Boromir bids Aragorn farewell and asks him to save his people at Minas Tirith.
events.quote: "Farewell, Aragorn! Go to Minas Tirith and save my people!"

events.summary: Isildur cuts the Ring from Sauron's hand, and Sauron is overthrown.
events.quote: Isildur cut the Ring from Sauron's hand with the hilt-shard of his father's sword, and Sauron himself was overthrown.

events.summary: Gandalf is besieged by the Nazgûl on Weathertop.
events.quote: "The Nazgûl closed round at night, and I was besieged.

events.summary: The Balrog is driven back by white fire.
events.quote: There was a ringing clash and a stab of white fire, and the Balrog fell back.

events.summary: Frodo puts on the Ring and Sauron becomes aware of his folly.
events.quote: As Frodo put on the Ring, Sauron was suddenly aware of the magnitude of his own folly.
"To Isengard with doom we come! With doom we come, with doom we come!"

events.summary: Galadriel passes the test and resolves to go into the West.
events.quote: "I pass the test. I will diminish, and go into the West, and remain Galadriel."
"Here do I swear fealty to Gondor, until my lord release me, or death take me."

events.summary: Aragorn plants the new White Tree in the court by the fountain.
events.quote: Aragorn planted the new tree in the court by the fountain, and swiftly and gladly it began to grow.
